metadata.title: Retail POS and Store Management Platform Data Assets
metadata.description: Catalog of merchandise, inventory, sales and payment, customer, omnichannel and platform data in the Vendit System, with GDPR and Dutch fiscal retention governance.

assets.name: Article and Assortment Master
assets.description: Articles, variants, barcodes, brands, revenue groups, images and online texts.
assets.businessMeaning: What the retailer can sell and how it is described in every channel.
assets.accessScope: Users of the owning retailer tenant according to their role; Vendit support on request.

interfaces.name: article and assortment master api
interfaces.description: Accessed through the bricks that use it.

governance.retention: Kept while the customer contract runs; exported on exit.
governance.sharingPolicy: Shared with connected partners only when the retailer enables a connector.

assets.name: Prices and Promotions
assets.description: Selling prices, price lists, promotions and purchase-price formulas per branch and channel.
assets.businessMeaning: The retailer's margin decisions.
assets.accessScope: Users of the owning retailer tenant according to their role; Vendit support on request.

interfaces.name: prices and promotions api
interfaces.description: Accessed through the bricks that use it.

governance.retention: Price history retained for margin analysis.
governance.sharingPolicy: Shared with connected partners only when the retailer enables a connector.

assets.name: Branch Formula Rules
assets.description: Which articles, prices and campaigns apply to which branch or franchisee.
assets.businessMeaning: How a chain or formula keeps its stores consistent.
assets.accessScope: Users of the owning retailer tenant according to their role; Vendit support on request.

interfaces.name: branch formula rules api
interfaces.description: Accessed through the bricks that use it.

governance.retention: Kept while the formula is active.
governance.sharingPolicy: Shared with connected partners only when the retailer enables a connector.

assets.name: Supplier Catalogue
assets.description: Supplier article files, purchase prices and supplier stock.
assets.businessMeaning: What can be ordered from whom at what price.
assets.accessScope: Users of the owning retailer tenant according to their role; Vendit support on request.

interfaces.name: supplier catalogue api
interfaces.description: Accessed through the bricks that use it.

governance.sharingPolicy: Shared with connected partners only when the retailer enables a connector.

assets.name: Purchase Orders and Receipts
assets.description: Purchase orders, electronic order messages and goods receipts.
assets.businessMeaning: Commitments to suppliers and incoming stock.
assets.accessScope: Users of the owning retailer tenant according to their role; Vendit support on request.

interfaces.name: purchase orders and receipts api
interfaces.description: Accessed through the bricks that use it.

governance.retention: Seven years as part of the books (Dutch fiscal retention).
governance.sharingPolicy: Shared with connected partners only when the retailer enables a connector.

rootGroups.name: Inventory Data
rootGroups.description: Stock positions, movements and serialised items.

assets.name: Stock Position
assets.description: Current stock per article, variant and location including reservations.
assets.businessMeaning: Whether the retailer can say yes to a customer in store or online.
assets.accessScope: Users of the owning retailer tenant according to their role; Vendit support on request.

interfaces.name: stock position api
interfaces.description: Accessed through the bricks that use it.

governance.retention: Current state; history in stock movements.
governance.sharingPolicy: Shared with connected partners only when the retailer enables a connector.

assets.name: Stock Movements
assets.description: Every stock mutation with reason: sale, return, receipt, transfer, count correction, write-off.
assets.businessMeaning: The audit trail behind stock value and shrinkage.
assets.accessScope: Users of the owning retailer tenant according to their role; Vendit support on request.

interfaces.name: stock movements api
interfaces.description: Accessed through the bricks that use it.

governance.sharingPolicy: Shared with connected partners only when the retailer enables a connector.

assets.name: Serialised Item Register
assets.description: Frame numbers, DPC numbers, serial numbers and gemstone specifications of individual items.
assets.businessMeaning: Proof of ownership, warranty and theft registration for high-value items.
assets.accessScope: Users of the owning retailer tenant according to their role; Vendit support on request.

interfaces.name: serialised item register api
interfaces.description: Accessed through the bricks that use it.

governance.retention: Kept for warranty period and traceability.
governance.sharingPolicy: Shared with connected partners only when the retailer enables a connector.

assets.name: Sales Transactions
assets.description: Receipts with lines, discounts, trade-ins, returns, staff and optional customer.
assets.businessMeaning: Turnover and the basis for margin, VAT and loyalty.
assets.accessScope: Users of the owning retailer tenant according to their role; Vendit support on request.

interfaces.name: sales transactions api
interfaces.description: Accessed through the bricks that use it.

governance.sharingPolicy: Shared with connected partners only when the retailer enables a connector.

assets.name: Payment Records
assets.description: Tender lines and terminal results (no full card numbers).
assets.businessMeaning: Proof of payment per receipt.
assets.accessScope: Users of the owning retailer tenant according to their role; Vendit support on request.

interfaces.name: payment records api
interfaces.description: Accessed through the bricks that use it.

governance.sharingPolicy: Shared with connected partners only when the retailer enables a connector.

assets.name: Cashbook and Day Closings
assets.description: Register openings, cash counts, tender totals and differences.
assets.businessMeaning: Whether the till balanced.
assets.accessScope: Users of the owning retailer tenant according to their role; Vendit support on request.

interfaces.name: cashbook and day closings api
interfaces.description: Accessed through the bricks that use it.

governance.sharingPolicy: Shared with connected partners only when the retailer enables a connector.

rootGroups.name: Customer Data
rootGroups.description: Customers, loyalty, orders, invoices and repairs.

assets.name: Customer Records
assets.description: Name, contact, address, consent and history of retail and B2B customers.
assets.businessMeaning: The retailer's relationship with its regulars.
assets.accessScope: Users of the owning retailer tenant according to their role; Vendit support on request.

interfaces.name: customer records api
interfaces.description: Accessed through the bricks that use it.

governance.retention: Until the customer asks for deletion or after a retailer-defined inactivity period.
governance.sharingPolicy: Shared with connected partners only when the retailer enables a connector.

assets.name: Loyalty Accounts and Vouchers
assets.description: Saving balances, issued value cheques, gift card balances and redemptions.
assets.businessMeaning: Liabilities to customers and the loyalty relationship.
assets.accessScope: Users of the owning retailer tenant according to their role; Vendit support on request.

interfaces.name: loyalty accounts and vouchers api
interfaces.description: Accessed through the bricks that use it.

governance.retention: While balance is open; history seven years.
governance.sharingPolicy: Shared with connected partners only when the retailer enables a connector.

assets.name: Quotes, Customer Orders and Reservations
assets.description: Quotes, orders, reservations and packing slips.
assets.businessMeaning: Promises made to customers.
assets.accessScope: Users of the owning retailer tenant according to their role; Vendit support on request.

interfaces.name: quotes, customer orders and reservations api
interfaces.description: Accessed through the bricks that use it.

governance.sharingPolicy: Shared with connected partners only when the retailer enables a connector.

assets.name: Invoices and Receivables
assets.description: Invoices, credit notes and open items.
assets.businessMeaning: Money owed to the retailer.
assets.accessScope: Users of the owning retailer tenant according to their role; Vendit support on request.

interfaces.name: invoices and receivables api
interfaces.description: Accessed through the bricks that use it.

governance.sharingPolicy: Shared with connected partners only when the retailer enables a connector.

assets.name: Repair Orders
assets.description: Repair intake, diagnosis, planned work, parts, labour and status.
assets.businessMeaning: Service promises and workshop capacity.
assets.accessScope: Users of the owning retailer tenant according to their role; Vendit support on request.

interfaces.name: repair orders api
interfaces.description: Accessed through the bricks that use it.

governance.retention: Warranty period plus fiscal retention when billed.
governance.sharingPolicy: Shared with connected partners only when the retailer enables a connector.

rootGroups.name: Omnichannel Data
rootGroups.description: Online orders, offers, shipments and returns.

assets.name: Online Orders
assets.description: Orders from the Vendit webshop, connected shops and marketplaces with customer and payment data.
assets.businessMeaning: Online demand that must be fulfilled from shared stock.
assets.accessScope: Users of the owning retailer tenant according to their role; Vendit support on request.

interfaces.name: online orders api
interfaces.description: Accessed through the bricks that use it.

governance.sharingPolicy: Shared with connected partners only when the retailer enables a connector.

assets.name: Marketplace Offers
assets.description: Which articles are listed on which marketplace, with status and price.
assets.businessMeaning: Online reach beyond the own webshop.
assets.accessScope: Users of the owning retailer tenant according to their role; Vendit support on request.

interfaces.name: marketplace offers api
interfaces.description: Accessed through the bricks that use it.

governance.sharingPolicy: Shared with connected partners only when the retailer enables a connector.

assets.name: Shipments and Returns
assets.description: Shipments, labels, track-and-trace and registered returns.
assets.businessMeaning: Delivery and return status per order.
assets.accessScope: Users of the owning retailer tenant according to their role; Vendit support on request.

interfaces.name: shipments and returns api
interfaces.description: Accessed through the bricks that use it.

governance.retention: Two years operational, longer when part of the books.
governance.sharingPolicy: Shared with connected partners only when the retailer enables a connector.

rootGroups.name: Insight and Platform Data
rootGroups.description: KPIs, accounting exports, configuration and support.

assets.name: Sales and Stock KPIs
assets.description: Turnover, margin, discount, transactions, average ticket, items per ticket, stock value per period, branch and group.
assets.businessMeaning: The numbers retailers steer on daily.
assets.accessScope: Users of the owning retailer tenant according to their role; Vendit support on request.

interfaces.name: sales and stock kpis api
interfaces.description: Accessed through the bricks that use it.

governance.sharingPolicy: Shared with connected partners only when the retailer enables a connector.

assets.name: Accounting Journal Export
assets.description: Journal batches of sales, cashbook and invoices for the accounting package.
assets.businessMeaning: The bridge to the retailer's books.
assets.accessScope: Users of the owning retailer tenant according to their role; Vendit support on request.

interfaces.name: accounting journal export api
interfaces.description: Accessed through the bricks that use it.

governance.sharingPolicy: Shared with connected partners only when the retailer enables a connector.

assets.name: Tenant and Store Configuration
assets.description: Tenant, branches, workstations, devices, modules and connectors.
assets.businessMeaning: How a retailer's Vendit environment is set up.
assets.accessScope: Users of the owning retailer tenant according to their role; Vendit support on request.

interfaces.name: tenant and store configuration api
interfaces.description: Accessed through the bricks that use it.

governance.sharingPolicy: Shared with connected partners only when the retailer enables a connector.

assets.name: Users and Roles
assets.description: Store staff users, roles and permissions.
assets.businessMeaning: Who may do what at the till and in the back office.
assets.accessScope: Users of the owning retailer tenant according to their role; Vendit support on request.

interfaces.name: users and roles api
interfaces.description: Accessed through the bricks that use it.

governance.sharingPolicy: Shared with connected partners only when the retailer enables a connector.

assets.name: Support Tickets
assets.description: Support requests, remote sessions and resolutions.
assets.businessMeaning: Service quality and recurring product issues.
assets.accessScope: Users of the owning retailer tenant according to their role; Vendit support on request.

interfaces.name: support tickets api
interfaces.description: Accessed through the bricks that use it.

governance.sharingPolicy: Shared with connected partners only when the retailer enables a connector.

stores.name: Retail Core Database
stores.description: Per-customer operational database of the Vendit System in the cloud: articles, prices, stock, sales, customers, orders.

stores.name: POS Local Buffer
stores.description: Local buffer on the store workstation for device profiles and pending sales (assumed).

stores.name: Webshop Database
stores.description: Online catalogue, content and checkout sessions of the Vendit webshop.

stores.name: Reporting Store
stores.description: Aggregated KPIs for the online dashboard and reports.

stores.name: Integration Queue
stores.description: Events and messages exchanged with partner and sibling platforms.
